name: Travel anywhere
author: kmomoney
description: Open the ship's planet select from anywhere: hold L1 + R1 and press Select. Pick a planet and the ship flies you there as usual. Back out and you carry on right where you were. Pick the planet you're on to restart its level from the beginning, keeping your bolts and items. It won't open at a few unsafe moments, such as while riding, playing as Clank or respawning; a message says why.

settings.name: Buttons
settings.description: Hold the two shoulder buttons and press Select to open the planet select. Select alone still opens the map; Off leaves only the keyboard key.

settings.name: Keyboard key
settings.description: A key that also opens the planet select. Pick one the game's controls don't use.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports. Writes what the mod sees and decides to the game's log.
